en: RANDOM PICK across many shelves no longer draws two shelves on top of each other, and a shelf leaving towards you no longer vanishes on its way out: the shelves move as one row of rows (thanks to @sm-steel for the report).
zh: 随机抽取跨越多个货架时不再出现两排货架叠在一起，朝你移出的货架也不再中途消失：所有货架作为一个整体移动（感谢 @sm-steel 的反馈）。
